observations.body: Paul counts former gains as loss, seeks to know Christ and resurrection power amid suffering, presses toward a goal, and ends with citizenship and bodily transformation.

payload.posture: Read Philippians 3:7–21 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul counts former gains as loss, seeks to know Christ and resurrection power amid suffering, presses toward a goal, and ends with citizenship and bodily transformation. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
